description: Place a real order at one store. Off unless the server was started with OSA_MCP_ALLOW_ORDERS=1. Spends the user's money. ALWAYS ask the human first: show them the store, items and the exact total from review_checkout and wait for an explicit yes. Pass approved_total equal to that review total; the order is refused if it differs, and the agent re-checks the total on the store before clicking.

approved_total.description: The review total in dollars that the human approved, e.g. 41.97

name: place_order
